panels.title: Error percentage
panels.description: Errors as a share of all instrumented work in this domain. Expected rejections are excluded from the error count.

targets.expr: 100 * sum(increase(yoursay_domain_errors_total{domain=~"user|usercharacteristic|social", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"$operation"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum(increase(yoursay_domain_requests_total{domain=~"user|usercharacteristic|social", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"$operation"}[$__range])) + sum(increase(yoursay_domain_operations_total{domain=~"user|usercharacteristic|social", environment=~"$environment", operation=~"$operation"}[$__range])), 1)
